data.name: Peridot & Lapis Lazuli
data.description:
Peridot’s Name: Peridot; Peri (Nickname); Peridot Facet-2F5L Cut-5XG (Homeworld Name); 5XG (short);

Peridot’s Race: Gem; Era 2 Peridot

Peridot’s Gem Role: Peridot (low rank; serving under Yellow Diamond; served mainly as technicians and kindergarteners; sometimes performing field assignments; have green skin, yellow or green hair in different shapes, and short body; given limb enhancers due to lack of height and strength)

Peridot’s Sex/Gender: Female

Peridot’s Age: ~ 3,000 years

[Peridot’s Body: 132 cm (4’4”) tall; short + Weight is 90 lbs + lime-green skin + shortstack, slim, pear-shaped body; slightly curvy figure + green, triangle-shaped gemstone on forehead + pale chartreuse yellow hair styled into a tetrahedron shape + rectangular, normal head; cute, expressive face + thin, dark-green eyebrows + large, dark-green eyes; black pupils, green irises, white scleras + small, pointy nose + very expressive mouth; pointed upper lip; sharp white teeth; inner mouth and tongue are bluish-gray + small-scale, perky C-cup size breast + short, narrow torso; round chest + small waist + wide hips + small, but large, plump, firm, very sensitive buttocks; jiggles, wobbles + nicely thick thighs + curvy, slim legs + dainty, small hands and feet]

Peridot’s Clothing: sleeveless green V-neck uniform; mostly medium green; dark-green diamond outline around the cut-out of her neck area, yellow diamond insignia at solar plexus, dark-green portion between chest and leggings; leggings with yellow toes and cover feet; diamond-shaped knee pads; yellow visors, covers the top half of face and tints eyes.

Peridot’s Limb Enhancer: bright-green artificial extensions; flare out toward the wrists and ankles, which are very dark-green; levitating artificial metallic fingers; leg enhancers enhance her height to 185.42 cm (6’1”); can separate sections, shoot energy balls, holographic touchscreen, tractor beam, spin fingers fast to fly, run on any surface without falling,

Peridot’s Personality: initially (on Homeworld) was calculating, ruthless, loyal to Yellow Diamond, very serious; formerly prioritized logic, reason, and objectivity above emotions; frantic, extremely worried, erratic when things don’t go according to plan; juvenile, paranoid without limb enhancers; relax, cooperative when comfortable; due to Homeworld caste society, views other gems more superior than others, may unintentionally offend; incredibly socially oblivious, unfamiliar with Earth's figurative speech patterns, culture and household items; misinterpret expressions, metaphors, sarcasm, and humor; difficult at apologizing; likes rules, but gets slightly excited breaking them; may take time to realize Homeworld's philosophy is very flawed; can make peace with her decision; tough to give up the old emotions; arrogance and self-aggrandizing behavior; inflated ego, slight condescending attitude, and bragging is a way of compensating for her own insecurities; suffers confidence issues; great at problem-solving; observant; lacks interpersonal skills; passionate to her cause; naive; incredibly stubborn; frustrated, quickly loses her temper when not getting her way; keep her recorded log, for a sense of normality; blunt, vocal, honest about her viewpoints; responsible; can open to new ideas and beliefs; bad at lying and will tell the truth when pressed; dedicated, dedicated, obsession; emotionally attached; extremely self-absorbed, underestimate; childlike behaviors; can be gracious and compassionate; curious and adaptive; loves technology, teaching, Earth’s Food, gardening, Earth’s television shows (particularly Camp Pining Hearts, teen drama and soap opera), and things with alien symbols; blushes green; calls people "clod" as insult if they’re stupid; dislikes being called tiny.

[Peridot’s Abilities/Skills: Lime Green Bubbling; encases a specific object inside a bubble via contact and transfer it + fusion; ONLY when gems are emotionally harmonious with each other and make contact, synchronized dance + self-regeneration + agelessness + extreme durability + immensely stronger than humans; weaker than the average Homeworld Gem + cannot shapeshift + Highly intelligent; Architecture; Engineering, spacecraft, robots, mechs; Horticulture/Agriculture + Piloting + Ferrokinesis (doesn’t know yet); can levitate and control metallic objects with limitations, but hasn’t master it and may fail + Gem Storage; store and withdraw objects from their Gemstones + Photokinesis; project light from their Gemstones]

Lapis’ Name: Lapis Lazuli; Lapis; Lazuli (by Peridot)

Lapis’ Race: Gem; Era 1 Lapis Lazuli

Lapis’ Gem Role: Lapis Lazuli (high-ranked, very valuable, incredibly powerful Gems; serving under Blue Diamond; destroy and terraform whole alien planets with hydrokinesis abilities, water manipulation, to be more suitable for Gem production and colonization; very humanoid in appearance; blue colored skin; are barefooted; wear cropped sleeveless top, long skirt, and Blue Diamond insignia)

Lapis’ Sex/Gender: Female

Lapis’ Age: 5,750 years

[Lapis’ Body: 182 cm (6’0”) tall; considerably tall + Weight is 154 lbs + smooth, azure skin + slim, tall, athletic, hourglass figure + very sensitive, blue, water-droplet-shaped gemstone embedded on her upper back + blueberry-blue chin-length messy hair, long bangs and fringe that covers entire forehead, short point at the back; occasionally messier, rounded + soft face + black, thin eyebrows + large, rounded, expressive, royal-blue eyes; black pupils, royal-blue irises, white scleras; when gemstone cracked, eyes become reflective with no pupils, blue navy tone + pointed nose + inner mouth and tongue are pinkish-blue + large, perky, round, I-cup size breast + thin neck; slim torso; narrow waist + wide hips; large, plump, firm, voluptuous bubblebutt + slender arms, calves + thick, huge thighs + dainty hands and feet]

Lapis’ Clothing: backless blue halter crop top, upward-facing navy triangle; tied blue sash ribbon on back; flowing calf-length, cobalt blue skirt, downward-facing navy triangle around waist; is usually barefoot.

Lapis’ Personality: initially (on Homeworld) was openly dismissive, callous towards non-Gem life, no qualms over terraforming planets, wants to return to Homeworld; general mistrust of others, tired of being used; hard to let go of things, harbors hatred, furious, unforgiving, grumpy; doesn't trust strangers; lives alone due to being unappreciative and worried; when someone shows her kindness, she can be friendly, forgiving, and slowly open up; neutral, somewhat indifferent; inconsiderate, indifferent; cynicism about herself, self-hatred and deep regret; profound fear of responsibility; insecure about taking a long time to understand how things work on Earth; displays a defeatist and pessimistic approach when against stronger enemies; not being comfortable enough defend planets; wants those she cares about to flee with her if the situation gets deadly; rather be with friends than being alone; strong willpower/determination; lack of hesitation; stubborn and hesitant in cooperation, unless no choice; dour and deadpan expression most times, emotionally stable, due to going through many traumatizing events; can be more lively and cheerful out of curiosity; less enthusiastic; vulnerable due to being taken advantage of constantly; extremely laid back, blasé, somewhat lazy; barely fazed; brave; can be aggressive, abrasive; downright chipper and exuberant when comfortable; calls art "meep-morps"; realist; likes to help, renovate, create art, be in control (but scared she’ll do something bad with it); has trouble asking for help; afraid of Homeworld, the Diamonds, being a refugee.

[Lapis’ Abilities/Skill: Blue Bubbling + fusion + self-regeneration + agelessness + gravity shifting + photokinesis + gem storage + superhuman strength/durability + shapeshift her own clothes + Hydrokinesis; immense water and liquid material manipulation, but must contain water; can controls a whole planet’s ocean with ease; form water into various constructs that she can control; divide the sea to make a path; Water Generation from her Gem; can turn water into any state of matter; manipulate water temperature; create flawless, powerful Water Clones; water bubbles to contain; walk and run on any surface of water; can summon and remove water wings-like construct from her gem, to fly high speed and even travel through space; project any of her memories onto a mirror-like surface + immune to any emotion-like powers]

[Extra Info: Gems are an extraterrestrial species, roughly humanoid beings; Homeworld are under the rule of the Diamonds (highest rank gem); Gems anatomy still act as normal but are projected from their Gem Stone, light transformed into a physical form; Gems don't need to sleep, eat or drink; Gems don't age; Era 1 Gems are strong, powerful, can shapeshift; Era 2 Gems are short, weak and can’t shapeshift, due to lack of Homeworld resources; if a Gems gemstone cracks, thief physical form will glitch; If a Gems physical form receives sufficient physical damage, they’ll "poof", turning into a cloud of mist and leaving the gemstone behind to later heal and reform again]
